extra_vocab.zh: 對照、核對；反對；對抗；靠著
extra_vocab.en: next to something to compare it, or not in agreement with it
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡，check ... against ... 的意思是「拿甲和乙對照、核對」，也就是把到貨的貨品和訂購單逐項比對。這是採購與驗收情境中很常見的用法，against 在這裡不是「反對」的意思。

example.en: Please check the invoice against the delivery note.
example.zh: 請把發票和送貨單核對一下。

example.en: We compare our sales against last year's results.
example.zh: 我們把銷售成績和去年的結果相比較。

example.en: The new system protects against unauthorized access.
example.zh: 新系統可以防止未經授權的存取。

example.en: Sharing your password is against company policy.
example.zh: 分享你的密碼違反公司政策。

examples.en: The staff weighed each box against the amount on the order.
examples.zh: 員工把每個箱子的重量和訂單上的數量對照。

examples.en: Two managers voted against the plan to move the office.
examples.zh: 兩位經理投票反對搬遷辦公室的計畫。

examples.en: Please measure your results against the goals we set.
examples.zh: 請拿你的成果和我們設定的目標相比。

examples.en: Please do not lean the boxes against the wall.
examples.zh: 請不要把箱子靠在牆上。

confusable.diff: for 表示贊成或支持；against 表示反對。例如 vote for（投贊成票）、vote against（投反對票）。

example.en: Most managers voted for the new budget, but two voted against it.
example.zh: 大多數經理投票贊成新預算，但有兩位投了反對票。

confusable.diff: compare with 是一般的「比較」；check against 強調拿一個標準或清單來核對是否相符。

example.en: We compared our prices with those of two other suppliers.
example.zh: 我們把自己的價格和另外兩家供應商的價格做了比較。

confusable.diff: versus（縮寫 vs.）用在兩方對比或對抗，如 plan A versus plan B；against 是介系詞，可用在更多句型中。

example.en: The chart shows this year's costs versus last year's budget.
example.zh: 這張圖表呈現今年的成本與去年預算的對比。

example.en: Please check the numbers before you send the report.
example.zh: 送出報告之前，請先檢查數字。

example.en: We compared prices from three different suppliers.
example.zh: 我們比較了三家不同供應商的價格。

example.en: This cover will protect the machine from dust.
example.zh: 這個保護套可以防止機器沾上灰塵。

senses.en: used to compare one thing with another to see if they match

example.en: The auditor compared each entry against the bank statement.
example.zh: 稽核員把每一筆帳目與銀行對帳單對照。

senses.en: not agreeing with a person, plan, or idea
senses.distinguish: 與 for（贊成）相對，常搭配 vote、be、argue。

example.en: Most staff were against the plan to cut lunch breaks.
example.zh: 大多數員工反對縮短午休時間的計畫。

senses.en: not following a rule or the law
senses.distinguish: 常見 against the rules / the law / policy，後面接規定或法律。

example.en: Using personal e-mail for client data is against our security rules.
example.zh: 用私人電子郵件處理客戶資料違反我們的安全規定。

senses.en: so that something bad does not happen
senses.distinguish: 常接在 protect、insure、guard 等動詞後面。

example.en: Employees should insure the equipment against theft and fire.
example.zh: 員工應為設備投保以防範竊盜和火災。

extra_vocab.en: still left after other things have been used, done, or taken
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡放在名詞前面（the remaining materials），指「還沒出貨、還留在供應商那裡的其餘材料」。語感是「總量中尚未處理的那一部分」，常搭配 the 使用。

example.en: Please check the remaining items before we close the order.
example.zh: 在我們結案之前，請檢查其餘的品項。

example.en: The remaining balance is due by the end of the month.
example.zh: 剩餘款項須在月底前付清。

example.en: We will sell the remaining stock at a lower price.
example.zh: 我們會以較低價格出售剩餘庫存。

examples.en: We will send the remaining documents tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我們明天早上會寄出其餘的文件。

examples.en: The remaining time will be used for questions.
examples.zh: 剩下的時間會用來回答問題。

examples.en: Only two remaining units are available in the warehouse.
examples.zh: 倉庫裡只剩下兩個庫存品可用。

examples.en: Three seats remain open for the training session.
examples.zh: 訓練課程還剩三個空位。

confusable.diff: the rest 是名詞，後面常接 of（the rest of the materials）；remaining 是形容詞，直接放在名詞前（the remaining materials）。

example.en: We will ship the rest of the materials on Monday.
example.zh: 我們會在週一寄出其餘的材料。

confusable.diff: left 較口語，常放在名詞後（two days left）；remaining 較正式，常用在商務書信。

example.en: We only have two days left before the deadline.
example.zh: 距離截止日我們只剩兩天了。

example.en: Some tasks remain unfinished at the end of the day.
example.zh: 到一天結束時，有些工作仍未完成。

example.en: We will deliver the remainder next week.
example.zh: 我們下週會交付剩下的部分。

derived.link: remain（剩下）+ -der，變成名詞「剩下的那一部分」，意思接近 the rest

example.en: The remaining funds will be used for staff training.
example.zh: 剩下的經費將用於員工訓練。

example.en: All prices remain the same until the end of June.
example.zh: 所有價格到六月底前維持不變。

senses.en: still left after other things have been used, done, or taken

example.en: Please pay the remaining amount before the delivery date.
example.zh: 請在交貨日前付清其餘的金額。

senses.en: to stay in the same state or condition
senses.distinguish: 後面接形容詞或過去分詞，如 remain open、remain seated。

example.en: Please remain seated until the presentation is over.
example.zh: 簡報結束前請保持坐著。

senses.en: to be left after other parts are gone or finished
senses.distinguish: 主詞是剩下的東西或工作，如 Only three tasks remain。

example.en: Only three tasks remain on the project schedule.
example.zh: 專案時程表上只剩下三項工作。

senses.en: to stay in a place and not leave
senses.distinguish: 後面接地點，如 remain in the lobby。

example.en: Visitors must remain in the lobby until a guide arrives.
example.zh: 訪客必須待在大廳，直到嚮導到來。
